summary: This program builds a list of Book objects and then creates a HashMap that pairs each book's title with its author, so an author can be retrieved by title in a single step. It looks up "The Hobbit" and prints the matching author.

lines.text: The variable is declared with the Map interface but created as a HashMap, the common subtype; the two type parameters say the keys are Strings (titles) and the values are Strings (authors).

The .put() method stores a key-value pair, so each pass through the loop files one book's author under its title. Keys are unique, so putting the same title twice would replace the earlier author rather than add a second entry.

This is the payoff of the map: .get() jumps straight to the pair stored under that key instead of looping through every Book and comparing titles. If no book had that title, .get() would hand back null.
